name: White Pork Bolognese Polenta Bowl with Zucchini & Hot-Honey Bacon (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta to the pan in a thin steady stream, whisking continuously, until incorporated. Add salt, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and creamy, 15-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup polenta (cornmeal)
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway, until zucchini is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a small bowl and set aside. (Discard all but 1 tablespoon of drippings and reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.

Return skillet (with reserved drippings) to medium-high heat, then add veggies, pork, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until veggies are tender and pork is cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb lean ground pork
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add honey and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the bacon. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp honey
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the pork is done, add milk and Parmesan to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole milk
⅔ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of polenta, 1 cup of zucchini, and 1 cup of bolognese between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining polenta, zucchini, and bolognese between bowls. Sprinkle with hot-honey bacon and enjoy!
